$why: THE PIPELINE'S TOOLS AS SHELL COMMANDS, NAMED BY A VARIABLE — NEVER BY A PATH (operator, 2026-10-01:
'hard coded local paths are not generated into prompts or SI text').
On a set whose runner does not host the pipeline's tools, an agent runs them through its shell. The
prompt names the variable (prompts/templates/pipeline-tools-command.json); the hub (llm-handler.sh)
exports each variable as the script beside it, so the agent's shell resolves it and no path is ever
written into a prompt. Keys are the variables; values are script names under orchestrations/scripts.
